scope: Headroom warm-request RSI ABBA adapter, read-only source and identity review
findings: The unchanged InferRSI runner with repetitions=2 produces A-B-B-A. Existing controllers and launch/media helper filenames, hashes, modes and stdout schemas match.
Each member starts a fresh service; both distinct seeds require accepted POST, exact graphs, eight uncached sampler steps, matching history endpoints, observer termination and owned cleanup.

Primary metric is the second native history timestamp difference, checked against the controller metric. First prompt and both complete media checks remain required; startup, asset hashing and TE are excluded from the primary metric.

Both actual MP4 bytes are rehashed against frozen identities. Media validation-summary/decode-result identities, end-of-file, unchanged input, 73 frames and audio samples are checked. Exact fixed outputs do not establish general perceptual equivalence.
Source snapshot checks occur around actual members and before child dispatch; actual IR import paths are checked. No fake Git revision or acceptance issue is introduced.

Resources are successful-member JSONL samples, not a guaranteed peak. Normal successful forced samples are written; failed guard evidence must also inspect actual result.last_sample, and an incomplete member emits no accepted metric.
Stop file is checked between children; active-child cancellation/deadline and owned process cleanup remain the existing executor/controller mechanisms. Parent must enforce quota during active work.
validation_command=None keeps formal evaluation INCONCLUSIVE; completion exit2 is expected and must not be confused with a model failure.
